subject: Release gate
verdict: Good idea. One thing to fix.
good: It names the two incidents it answers.

findings.title: The check runs too early
findings.evidence: Both incidents broke at release, after the merge check had passed.

comments.quote: makes a breaking change between the two apps impossible
comments.text:
Problem: The check runs at merge, but both incidents broke at release. I am not sure it would have stopped them.
Proposal: I think we could compare against the version live in production before each release.
Example: App A ships on Monday and app B on Thursday. Monday's check never sees B's change, so users get a broken page on Thursday.

confidence.why: Both incidents show it. The check was not run at release.
